title: Curbox – Free Open-Source App Blocker for Android (Block Reels & Shorts)
description:
Curbox is a free open-source Android app that blocks distracting apps and websites. It specifically targets Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, and even lets you hide parts of an app's UI. Install from F-Droid or GitHub.
